title.narrative: St. Kitts and Nevis Orientation for students/existing teachers for the Open University of Tanzania (OUT) Bachelor’s Degree Programme

description.narrative:
The Ministry of Education continues to work assertively to ensure that St. Kitts and Nevis teacher education and professionalization programmes and frameworks are designed and developed to help a continuing large proportion of unqualified teachers acquire the required qualifications and attain the professionalism standards within a determined period, in line with the policy recommendations outlined by the UNESCO expert.
St. Kitts and Nevis is thus pursuing advanced negotiations with the Open University of Tanzania (OUT) to enable some 25 national teachers, lacking an undergraduate qualification, to gain access to the on-line bachelor’s degree programme delivered by the OUT, with courses provided remotely.
